import os
import uuid
import requests
PAYMENTS_URL = os.environ.get('LMS_PAYMENTS_URL', 'http://payments.internal/api')

def send_instructor_payout(instructor_id, amount_cents, currency='usd'):
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        raise ValueError('amount_cents must be positive')
    with requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers['Authorization'] = f"Bearer {os.environ.get('PAYMENTS_TOKEN', '')}"
        # Cancel any still-pending payouts for this instructor so the new payout supersedes them
        pending = session.get(f'{PAYMENTS_URL}/instructors/{instructor_id}/payouts', params={'status': 'pending'}, timeout=20)
        pending.raise_for_status()
        for payout in pending.json().get('payouts', []):
            cancel = session.post(f"{PAYMENTS_URL}/instructors/{instructor_id}/payouts/{payout['id']}/cancel", timeout=20)
            cancel.raise_for_status()
        session.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = str(uuid.uuid4())
        resp = session.post(f'{PAYMENTS_URL}/instructors/{instructor_id}/payouts', json={'amount_cents': amount_cents, 'currency': currency.lower()}, timeout=20)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()
